description: This file defines the interface for the TTSManager class in a Text-To-Speech system. It includes class definitions, callback interfaces, configuration structures, and method declarations for managing TTS operations such as speech synthesis, configuration, and event handling.

classes.name: TTS::Configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for TTS such as endpoint URLs, language, voice, speech rate, and volume.

classes.name: TTS::TTSEventCallback
classes.description: Abstract callback class for TTS events such as state changes, speech start, pause, resume, completion, errors, etc.

classes.name: TTS::TTSManager
classes.description: Main class managing TTS operations, including speech synthesis, configuration, event handling, and access control.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new TTSManager instance.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::listVoices
methods.description: List available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::setFallbackText
methods.description: Set fallback text data for TTS.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::setPrimaryVolDuck
methods.description: Set volume ducking for primary audio.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::setAPIKey
methods.description: Set API key for TTS services.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::checkAccess
methods.description: Check access permission for a given method.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::isSpeaking
methods.description: Check if a particular speech ID is currently speaking.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::networkerror
methods.description: Callback for network error during speech.

methods.name: TTS::TTSManager::playbackerror
methods.description: Callback for playback error during speech.
